description: Northern Gas Networks Distribution Mains is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Line features representing live low and medium pressure Northern Gas Networks gas main pipes. This dataset is intended for use in a geographical information system and contains pipe routes with associated attribution, such as pipe material and size. This GeoPackage dataset is created by Northern Gas Networks with data from their central geospatial database. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Gas and Third Party, New Dataset. The portal shows 2026-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
